authorizationPolicy.description: A simulated CBCC processing scenario may only be applied while the acting session holds the payment:operate capability; scenarios never carry raw PII or restricted screening logic, only sanitized reason codes and safe copy.

latencyPolicy.description: Simulated CBCC processing latency is bounded and clamped by the mock envelope layer; min_latency_ms and max_latency_ms are hints for deterministic demo behavior.

checkStages.label: Funds check
checkStages.description: Confirms sufficient available balance is reserved on the source account before the payment proceeds.

checkStages.label: Fraud check
checkStages.description: Simulated fraud risk evaluation using sanitized outcome codes only; no restricted screening logic is exposed.

checkStages.label: AML / FTR check
checkStages.description: Simulated anti-money-laundering and funds-transfer-reporting evaluation using sanitized outcome codes only.

checkStages.label: Sanctions check
checkStages.description: Simulated sanctions screening using sanitized outcome codes only; no restricted watchlist logic is exposed.

checkResults.label: Passed
checkResults.description: The check completed without raising any concern.

checkResults.label: Manual review
checkResults.description: The check raised a concern that requires manual review before the payment can proceed.

checkResults.label: Repair required
checkResults.description: The check found a correctable data issue that must be repaired before the payment can proceed.

checkResults.label: Failed
checkResults.description: The check failed and the payment cannot proceed in its current form.

checkResults.label: Skipped
checkResults.description: The check was not evaluated because an earlier blocking check already halted processing.

outcomes.label: Accepted
outcomes.description: All processing checks passed and the payment is accepted for settlement.

outcomes.label: Rejected
outcomes.description: A blocking check failed and the payment has been rejected.

outcomes.label: Pending review
outcomes.description: A check requires manual review; the payment is held pending an operator decision.

outcomes.label: Repair required
outcomes.description: A correctable data issue was found; the payment must be repaired and resubmitted.

reasonCodes.label: Accepted
reasonCodes.description: The payment cleared all processing checks and was accepted.

reasonCodes.label: Insufficient funds
reasonCodes.description: The source account did not hold sufficient available balance to cover the instructed amount and charges.

reasonCodes.label: Fraud review
reasonCodes.description: The payment was flagged for manual fraud review before it can proceed.

reasonCodes.label: AML review
reasonCodes.description: The payment was flagged for manual anti-money-laundering review before it can proceed.

reasonCodes.label: Sanctions review
reasonCodes.description: The payment was flagged for manual sanctions review before it can proceed.

reasonCodes.label: Sanctions rejected
reasonCodes.description: The payment could not be released following sanctions screening and has been rejected.

reasonCodes.label: Beneficiary details repair
reasonCodes.description: The beneficiary details require correction before the payment can be reprocessed.

reasonCodes.label: Remittance info repair
reasonCodes.description: The remittance information is incomplete or malformed and must be repaired before reprocessing.

reasonCodes.label: Processing unavailable
reasonCodes.description: The processing service is temporarily unavailable and produced no result.

next_step.title: Payment accepted
next_step.body: All processing checks passed and this payment has been accepted for settlement.

next_step.title: Insufficient funds
next_step.body: The source account did not hold sufficient available balance for this payment. Review the account balance and resubmit if appropriate.

next_step.title: Held for fraud review
next_step.body: This payment has been flagged for manual fraud review. An operator must review it before it can proceed.

next_step.title: Held for AML review
next_step.body: This payment has been flagged for manual anti-money-laundering review. An operator must review it before it can proceed.

next_step.title: Held for sanctions review
next_step.body: This payment has been flagged for manual sanctions review. An operator must review it before it can proceed.

next_step.title: Payment rejected
next_step.body: This payment could not be released following sanctions screening and has been rejected. No funds were moved.

next_step.title: Beneficiary details need repair
next_step.body: The beneficiary details require correction before this payment can be reprocessed. Repair the details and resubmit.

next_step.title: Remittance info needs repair
next_step.body: The remittance information is incomplete or malformed and must be repaired before this payment can be reprocessed.

next_step.title: Processing unavailable
next_step.body: The processing service is temporarily unavailable and produced no result. Wait a moment and try processing again.
